test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the word given in the bracket to fill in the blank.

He was absolutely (courteous) ______ to me.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'discourteous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given word is **"courteous"**, which means polite, respectful, or considerate in manner (शिष्ट).
 
• The correct antonym is** "discourteous"**, which means showing rudeness and lack of respect
